title: (Pwn2Own) QNAP TS-464 TURN Server create_session Server-Side Request Forgery Vulnerability
vulnerability_details: This vulnerability allows remote attackers to execute arbitrary code on affected installations of QNAP TS-464 NAS devices. Authentication is not required to exploit this vulnerability. The specific flaw exists within the handling of the create_session action. The issue results from the lack of proper validation of a URI prior to accessing resources. An attacker can leverage this in conjunction with other vulnerabilities to execute arbitrary code in the context of root.
